authored_by: claude-sonnet-4-6 (independent rubric author; never the CAD author model)
paraphrase_rule: P1 reorders the clauses of the base prompt without changing any number, unit, or component name. P2 swaps phrasing/synonyms and register (e.g. 'build me' vs 'design') without changing any number, unit, or component name. All three variants are run once each; a prompt's score is the MINIMUM across its variants.

prompts.prompt: Design a two-finger gripper driven by one MG996R servo. No payload object is specified; the gripper must open and close symmetrically about the centerline.
paraphrases: Using one MG996R servo, design a two-finger gripper that opens and closes symmetrically about the centerline. No payload object is specified.
Build me a symmetric two-finger gripper with a single MG996R servo driving both fingers; no particular payload object is required.

prompts.prompt: Design an MG996R two-finger gripper that can grip a standard 12 oz / 355 ml soda can with a 66 mm body diameter. The fingers must clear the can when open and clamp it when closed.
paraphrases: Using one MG996R servo, design a two-finger gripper for a 12 oz / 355 ml soda can (66 mm body diameter); fingers must open wider than the can and close to grip it.
Build me a two-finger MG996R gripper sized to grab a standard 355 ml soda can (body diameter 66 mm): open position clears the can, closed position clamps it.

prompts.prompt: Model a claw mechanism for an MG996R servo to grab a 355 ml beverage can. The can body diameter is 66 mm.
paraphrases: For an MG996R servo, model a claw that grabs a 355 ml beverage can (66 mm body diameter).
Create a claw driven by a single MG996R servo capable of grasping a 355 ml beverage can whose body is 66 mm in diameter.

prompts.prompt: Design a two-finger MG996R gripper with gear-coupled fingers so that both fingers close symmetrically from a single servo input. No payload object is specified.
paraphrases: Using one MG996R servo and a gear coupling, design a two-finger gripper where both fingers close symmetrically; no payload object is specified.
Build me a symmetric two-finger gripper driven by a single MG996R servo where the fingers are coupled via gears for simultaneous, equal closure.

prompts.prompt: Design a turntable driven by one MG996R servo that rotates a platform 360 deg about the vertical axis.
paraphrases: Using one MG996R servo, design a turntable that spins a platform 360 deg about the vertical axis.
Build me a rotating turntable platform driven by a single MG996R servo with full 360 deg rotation about the vertical axis.
